metadata.methods_description: Participants performed a passive viewing task in a dimly lit room, viewing a game board with game pieces and a mesh occluder. Each trial began with a fixation cross, followed by a two-second presentation of the partially occluded scene (game pieces appearing only in the final second), then removal of the occluder to reveal the uncovered scene for one second. The experiment comprised eight blocks of 80 trials, with 16 conditions (2 initial visibility levels x 8 uncovering levels) each repeated 40 times, totaling 640 trials. Three participants were excluded due to excessive head movement or equipment malfunction.
